description: This file defines a static class 'TypescriptClassSerializer' responsible for serializing 'ClassDefinition' objects into TypeScript class source code. It includes a method 'ToSource' which constructs the TypeScript class as a string, including imports, class signature, variables, and methods.

classes.name: TypescriptClassSerializer
classes.description: A static class providing functionality to serialize 'ClassDefinition' objects into TypeScript class source code.

methods.name: ToSource
methods.description: Converts a 'ClassDefinition' instance into a formatted TypeScript class source code string.
